meta.description: Machine-readable dead-code core validation scope and bounded manual intent-review guidance. Validation and runtime consumers share this owner without treating guidance as observed wiring evidence.

questions: Inspect actual import/export consumers and callback, UI-action or state bindings before interpreting this unused symbol as unfinished integration.
Look for contrary evidence: intentionally obsolete behavior, retained public/framework contracts, dynamic entrypoints or existing consumers.
Keep delete, complete_integration, retain_contract and unknown separate; obtain target-native or runtime evidence where static observations cannot decide.

contract_triage_invariant: Graph non-consumption is not deletion authority; protected contract rows remain visible with mutation_proposed=false and explicit binding status.
reachability_unknown_invariant: A structural inventory or degraded parser may expose symbols, but it cannot emit dead-code candidates until its language capability and file parser evidence satisfy the canonical reachability contract.
